measure.js: (function(){const out=[];for(const p of document.querySelectorAll('p')){const t=p.firstChild;const r=document.createRange();const lines=[];let top=null;for(const m of t.data.matchAll(/\S+/g)){r.setStart(t,m.index);r.setEnd(t,m.index+m[0].length);const y=Math.round(r.getBoundingClientRect().top);if(y!==top){lines.push([]);top=y;}lines[lines.length-1].push(m[0]);}out.push(lines.map(l=>l.join(' ')).join('|'));}return out;})()
